unity_import.note: Import PNG exports for predictable runtime use. SVG files are editable masters and animated previews; Unity's SVG importer does not execute CSS/SVG animation.

ghost_main_8x4.png.purpose: Main character body; one fixed silhouette, directional eye placement only.

shade_stalker_4x4.png.purpose: Single enemy design, four facing directions.

cosmetic_hat_witch_8x4.png.purpose: Render above character; same cell layout as body.

cosmetic_wings_moth_8x4.png.purpose: Render behind character; same cell layout as body.

data_policy.unlocked_cosmetics: Account progression; persist permanently once unlocked.
data_policy.equipped_cosmetics: Account loadout; persist between expeditions and devices.
data_policy.expedition_loot: Separate temporary run inventory; does not contain cosmetics.

source_vs_runtime.svg: Editable vector master files; use for art revisions and browser previews.
source_vs_runtime.png: Recommended runtime atlas exports for the initial Unity prototype.
source_vs_runtime.animation: Use Unity Animator clips from atlas frames; CSS/SVG preview animation does not become a Unity AnimationClip.
